title: Charlotte Maxeke
summary: Charlotte Maxeke studied at Wilberforce University in Ohio. In 1913 she helped organise a mass meeting of women in Bloemfontein, where women decided to stop carrying their passes, and in 1918 she founded the Bantu Women's League. In 1928 she set up an employment agency for Africans in Johannesburg, and she was the first black woman parole officer for juvenile delinquents. She died in Johannesburg in 1939; her birth year is variously given as 1871, 1872 or 1874.

uncertainty.note: Sources disagree on birth: 1874 (OpenLearn), 7 April 1872 per her sister Katy (National Museum Bloemfontein publication), 1871 (Wilberforce/Payne library guide). The 1872 midpoint is used with a range. Death year 1939 in all three; exact date not given by the pages opened.
